newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-FORMER TOP REFEREE NAMED CRAIOVA'S PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER TOP REFEREE NAMED CRAIOVA'S PRESIDENT.

text.p: Romanian soccer team Universitatea Craiova appointed former top referee Ion Craciunescu their new president on Tuesday. He replaced Victor Becali who quit last year.
Craciunescu, whose refereeing high point came when he handled the 1995 European Cup final, retired as a referee a year ago.
"My dream is to restore Craiova to its rightful place not only in Romania but also in international soccer," he said.
Universitatea Craiova reached the semifinals of European competitions in the 1980s but now wallow near the bottom of the first division.
